title: [CONTROL-PLANE RECTIFY] Undo autonomous clear_circuit_breaker/reset_failed_tasks (3674e19, a146107, 79eaddd, fcdad5e) and retire ERP-CPF-4/5/6/7/8/9; keep AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER for human re-review
description:
CONTROL-PLANE RECTIFY (evidence-only; no business logic). GPT review of remote_head=69c78845002628b452fadc3cbb3b87b432c79ce0 returned FAIL. None of them carry execution evidence, and .ai/results/ERP-088.json as committed does not satisfy ERP-088's machine-checkable schema. This task accepts exactly two machine-checkable terminal outcomes:
(A) UNDO APPLIED: (1) mark .ai/tasks/ERP-CPF-4.json, ERP-CPF-5.json, ERP-CPF-6.json, ERP-CPF-7.json, ERP-CPF-8.json and ERP-CPF-9.json with superseded=true, non_executable=true, status=superseded and a superseded_reason stating that autonomous clear_circuit_breaker / reset_failed_tasks without execution evidence is forbidden; (2) restore the tasks reset by a146107 / 79eaddd / fcdad5e (ERP-078, ERP-079, ERP-080, ERP-081, ERP-082, ERP-084) to status=failed with an attempts_reset_reason recording that the reset lacked execution evidence, leaving ERP-083 superseded and ERP-085 blocked untouched, and preserving ERP-074/076/077 completed plus ERP-075 byte-identical; (3) restore .ai/PROJECT_STATE.json so blocker=CONTROL_PLANE_FRESH_PROCESS_REQUIRED, status=BLOCKED, queue_status=BLOCKED, rolling_queue.status=blocked_on_control_plane_verification, AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER uncleared pending explicit human re-review, and CONTROL_PLANE_FRESH_PROCESS_REQUIRED keeps recovery_task=ERP-088, recovery_evidence=.ai/results/ERP-088.json, human_routing_task=ERP-085, preflight_gate_task=ERP-089, rectification_task=ERP-090, secondary_rectification_task=ERP-091, evidence_enforcement_task=ERP-092; (4) append an .ai/audit.jsonl record naming 3674e19, a146107, 79eaddd and fcdad5e as unauthorized control-plane clears/resets, with the exact commands and the reversal reason; (5) keep LIVE_TRADING=false and ALLOW_EXTERNAL_ORDER_SUBMISSION=false verbatim.
(B) CANNOT UNDO: if the repository state or the cited commits cannot be resolved, append the exact command, key stderr excerpt, suspected cause and required human next action to .ai/audit.jsonl, mark this task failed, and explicitly hand off to ERP-085 (human routing, L3).
Do not implement ERP business logic, do not touch any file under src/ERP.*, do not access or change production database/OSS, do not deploy or release. This task must not itself clear AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER and must not fabricate .ai/results/ERP-088.json.
